capabilities: Change the moment.js locale used for datetime formatting
Localize dates shown by plugins that use moment.js, such as Tasks
disambiguation: Not a plugin translator; it only changes the locale used for date and time formatting, not interface text.
extras: The README warns never to delete or disable the plugin after installing it, because the locale will not revert when the plugin is disabled.
problem: Obsidian does not support changing the internal moment.js locale, so datetime strings from plugins like Tasks appear in the wrong language.

relations.evidence: Customize the datetime language for plugins using moment.js, such as Tasks.

summary: Utility that changes the moment.js locale so dates and times across Obsidian and its plugins display in the chosen language.
